title: isolepis hemiuncialis
intro: Isolepis hemiuncialis, commonly known as Marsh Club-rush, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Isolepis hemiuncialis include its ability to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
